intro: Kanpur has only one official UGC-DEB Online MBA provider on this page: Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University (CSJMU). The university is published on College Decision and is on the official 2026-27 entitled list. This is a short list on purpose; it does not treat IIT Kanpur, a study centre or a national brand as a Kanpur Online MBA college.

If you are searching for the best Online MBA colleges in Kanpur, CSJMU is the local official option. You can still join a national UGC-entitled Online MBA from Kanpur, but those universities are not Kanpur colleges and are not listed here. Compare them on the all-India [Online MBA college list](/online-mba-colleges).

sections.h2: Best Online MBA colleges in Kanpur
paragraphs: [CSJM University, Kanpur](/colleges/chhatrapati-shahu-ji-maharaj-university-csjm-university-uttar-pradesh-kanpur), formerly Kanpur University, offers a two-year, four-semester Online MBA through its Centre for Distance and Online Education. The official university page states eligibility as graduation in any discipline with 50 per cent marks, and a 5 per cent relaxation for SC and ST candidates. The same page lists the tuition fee as ₹33,000 per annum. Other charges were not published there, so they are not invented here.

CSJMU is a public, NAAC A++ and Category-1 university. It is entitled, not merely recognised, on the UGC-DEB 2026-27 list. It did not appear in the NIRF 2025 university top 200, so we have not assigned it a NIRF university rank. Open the college profile, then confirm the current CDOE prospectus and fee notice before you apply.

sections.h2: What this Kanpur list does not include
paragraphs: Pages titled “top Online MBA colleges in Kanpur 2026” often lead with featured or nearby colleges from other cities, or with programmes that are not a UGC-DEB Online MBA. IIT Kanpur is a published institute in the city, but it is not on the official UGC-DEB entitled or recognised Online MBA lists, so it is not on this page. Study-centre or franchise listings are not universities and are not listed either.

For other official providers in the state, see [Online MBA colleges in Uttar Pradesh](/online-mba-colleges-in-uttar-pradesh). For national UGC-entitled options you can study from Kanpur, use the [all-India Online MBA college list](/online-mba-colleges) and match the university on the current UGC-DEB list.

faqs.question: How many official Online MBA colleges are there in Kanpur?
faqs.answer: There is one official UGC-DEB Online MBA provider based in Kanpur on this page: CSJM University. If another website shows dozens of Kanpur results, check whether those entries are featured or nearby colleges, national brands, or programmes that are not a UGC-DEB Online MBA.

faqs.question: What is the Online MBA fee at CSJMU Kanpur?
faqs.answer: The official CSJMU CDOE page lists the tuition fee as ₹33,000 per annum for the two-year Online MBA. That is ₹66,000 in tuition over two years if the annual tuition stays the same. Examination or other charges were not published on that page, so confirm the payable amount for your intake with the university.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for the CSJMU Online MBA?
faqs.answer: The official university page asks for graduation from a recognised university in any discipline, with a minimum of 50 per cent marks and a 5 per cent relaxation for SC and ST candidates. Follow the current CDOE admission notice for documents, deadlines and any additional checks.

faqs.question: Is IIT Kanpur on this Online MBA list?
faqs.answer: No. IIT Kanpur is a well-known published institute in the city, but it is not on the official UGC-DEB 2026-27 entitled or recognised lists for an Online MBA, so it is not included here. This page is only for official UGC-DEB Online MBA providers based in Kanpur.

faqs.question: Can I do a national Online MBA while living in Kanpur?
faqs.answer: Yes. A UGC-DEB entitled or recognised Online MBA can usually be studied from Kanpur even when the university is based elsewhere. Those universities are not listed as Kanpur colleges on this page. Use the all-India Online MBA college list to compare them, and still check the official UGC-DEB list.
